Back to School Supplies with Savings on MVA Transactions! Clinton Office is Moving!

Jul 23, 2026

Can’t believe it’s almost back to school time!

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:08
Instaread

MD Express Tag & Title has started their Back-To-School Drive until August 6, 2026. Get $5.00 off all MVA services, including Duplicate Titles, Temp and Permanent Tag Registration, Vehicle Renewal Registration, and Tag Returns, when you drop off a school supply at any of our locations or make a monetary contribution.

MD Express Tag & Title partnered with Jamaur Law, an organization that promotes financial literacy for the youth and other each age group, to support local children with back-to-school supplies.

Together, we can help local students start the school year with confidence. Thank you for supporting our community.

Donate Supplies Now
Support Our Mission

Our Clinton MD Express Tag & Title inside Walmart is moving!

Effective August 1, our Clinton office will be located at 8081 Branch Avenue, Clinton, MD 21076, near the Branch Avenue Auto Auction. Our Clinton Staff will be ready to process all of your Vehicle Tag Transactions with exceptional customer service in our new spacious location in a newly developed strip mall with ample parking!

We look forward to seeing you there!

For more information, please contact us at 888-938-2448.
